virtio_net currently only frees old transmit skbs just
before queueing new ones. If the queue is full
enables interrupts and waits for notification that more
work has been performed.
However
column2: a side-effect of this scheme is that there are

column1: always xmit skbs left dangling when no new packets are
sent
guideline:
""... it is not allowed for your TX mitigation scheme
to let TX packets ""hang out"" in the TX ring unreclaimed
forever if no new TX packets are sent.""
Add a timer to ensure that any time we queue new TX
skbs
column2: we will shortly free them again.

column1: This fixes an easily reproduced hang at shutdown where
iptables attempts to unload nf_conntrack and nf_conntrack
waits for an skb it is tracking to be freed
never frees it.
